protocol.affinity: One first-allowed logical CPU shared by runner, decoder threads and one spawned background worker; masks verified; runner masks restored.
protocol.releases: Twelve absolute 1 Hz releases per foreground trial, sequential execution without drops; deadline measured from release including queueing.
protocol.background: Same public PBKDF2 input and iteration count in every mode; checksum checked each chunk; count only completions within the fixed 12-second window.
protocol.barrier: Worker ready after setup/warmup, then armed acknowledgement and common future monotonic start/end timestamps.
protocol.overload: All scheduled foreground jobs finish, even after window end; background stops independently at fixed end; overruns and boundary chunks remain explicit.
protocol.cpu_scope: Live parent, decoder worker and background process CPU clocks. Accounting extends through foreground backlog and final boundary chunk; offsets recorded separately.
protocol.excluded: Initialization, warmup, process creation and final close excluded. Required foreground work and output checks included. No clocks, priorities or global settings changed.
protocol.limits: No energy inference. Accounting covers named processes; other processes and spawn bookkeeping are excluded. Driver IRQs/kernel workqueues are not constrained by process affinity. Raw ranges retained; small/noisy or null effects are valid outcomes.
protocol.status: Pass means protocol, outputs and provenance verified. Deadline qualification is reported separately; throughput gains with missed deadlines do not establish the requested service level.
